description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, providing a chainable logging mechanism within the application's logging framework.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then propagates the log to the next node if present.
